name: Adolf Hitler
reason: Instigator of the Holocaust (about six million Jews murdered) and of other Nazi genocides and war crimes.

name: Joseph Stalin
reason: Responsible for the Great Purge, the Gulag system, mass deportations of peoples and the 1932–33 famine; established crimes against humanity.

name: Mao Zedong
reason: Led the Great Leap Forward (famine killing tens of millions) and the Cultural Revolution's mass persecutions.

name: Pol Pot
reason: Led the Khmer Rouge regime responsible for the Cambodian genocide (about 1.5 to 2 million deaths, 1975–79).

name: Heinrich Himmler
reason: Head of the SS and chief organizer of the Holocaust.

name: Hermann Göring
reason: Convicted at Nuremberg of war crimes and crimes against humanity.

name: Adolf Eichmann
reason: Organizer of the deportation of Jews to extermination camps; convicted in Jerusalem (1961) of crimes against humanity.

name: Reinhard Heydrich
reason: Chaired the Wannsee Conference and organized the Holocaust and Einsatzgruppen massacres.

name: Joseph Goebbels
reason: Nazi propaganda minister, central to the persecution of Jews and the Holocaust.

name: Joachim von Ribbentrop
reason: Convicted at Nuremberg of war crimes and crimes against humanity.

name: Martin Bormann
reason: Convicted in absentia at Nuremberg of war crimes and crimes against humanity.

name: Rudolf Hess
reason: Convicted at Nuremberg of crimes against peace and conspiracy.

name: Josef Mengele
reason: SS physician at Auschwitz, selected prisoners for gas chambers and carried out lethal experiments.

name: Benito Mussolini
reason: Fascist dictator; war crimes in Ethiopia and Libya (including chemical weapons) and anti-Jewish racial laws.

name: Hideki Tojo
reason: Convicted by the International Military Tribunal for the Far East of war crimes.

name: Leopold II of Belgium
reason: His Congo Free State regime caused mass atrocities and millions of deaths through forced labour.

name: Talaat Pasha
reason: Main architect of the Armenian genocide (1915–1917).

name: Enver Pasha
reason: Ottoman triumvir co-responsible for the Armenian genocide.

name: Lothar von Trotha
reason: Commanded the genocide of the Herero and Nama peoples (1904–1908).

name: Lavrentiy Beria
reason: Soviet secret police chief responsible for mass executions (including the Katyn massacre) and deportations.

name: Francisco Franco
reason: His regime carried out mass executions and repression (the White Terror) during and after the Spanish Civil War.

name: Ante Pavelić
reason: Leader of the Ustaše regime responsible for genocide against Serbs, Jews and Roma.

name: Ion Antonescu
reason: Romanian dictator responsible for the deaths of hundreds of thousands of Jews and Roma; executed for war crimes in 1946.

name: Philippe Pétain
reason: Head of the Vichy regime, which collaborated in the deportation of Jews to Nazi death camps; convicted of treason in 1945.

name: Pierre Laval
reason: Vichy head of government who organized the deportation of Jews; executed for treason in 1945.

name: Idi Amin
reason: His regime killed an estimated 100,000 to 500,000 Ugandans.

name: Saddam Hussein
reason: Responsible for the Anfal campaign against the Kurds including the Halabja chemical attack; executed after conviction for crimes against humanity.

name: Slobodan Milošević
reason: Indicted by the ICTY for genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes; died before the verdict.

name: Radovan Karadžić
reason: Convicted by the ICTY of genocide (Srebrenica) and crimes against humanity.

name: Ratko Mladić
reason: Convicted by the ICTY of genocide (Srebrenica) and crimes against humanity.

name: Charles Taylor
reason: Convicted by the Special Court for Sierra Leone of war crimes and crimes against humanity.

name: Jean Kambanda
reason: Prime minister during the genocide against the Tutsi; convicted of genocide by the ICTR.

name: Théoneste Bagosora
reason: Convicted by the ICTR for his role in the genocide against the Tutsi.

name: Mengistu Haile Mariam
reason: Led the Red Terror in Ethiopia; convicted of genocide in absentia in 2006.

name: Rafael Trujillo
reason: Ordered the 1937 Parsley massacre of thousands of Haitians.

name: Augusto Pinochet
reason: His regime killed and disappeared thousands and tortured tens of thousands; charged with crimes against humanity before his death.

name: Jorge Rafael Videla
reason: Convicted of crimes against humanity for the Dirty War disappearances in Argentina.

name: Efraín Ríos Montt
reason: Convicted of genocide against the Maya Ixil in 2013 (verdict later annulled on procedural grounds).

name: Hissène Habré
reason: Convicted by the Extraordinary African Chambers of crimes against humanity, war crimes and torture.

name: Francisco Macías Nguema
reason: His regime killed or drove into exile a large share of Equatorial Guinea's population; convicted of genocide in 1979.

name: Yahya Khan
reason: Head of state during the 1971 Bangladesh genocide.

name: Suharto
reason: Rose to power through the 1965–66 mass killings in Indonesia; his regime committed atrocities in East Timor.

name: Kim Il Sung
reason: Founded the North Korean system of political prison camps; UN inquiry (2014) found crimes against humanity.

name: Kim Jong Il
reason: Ruled North Korea during the 1990s famine and the prison camp system; UN inquiry (2014) found crimes against humanity.

name: Khieu Samphan
reason: Convicted by the Khmer Rouge Tribunal of genocide and crimes against humanity.

name: Nuon Chea
reason: Convicted by the Khmer Rouge Tribunal of genocide and crimes against humanity.

name: Ieng Sary
reason: Khmer Rouge leader charged with genocide and crimes against humanity; died during trial.

name: Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi
reason: Leader of the Islamic State, whose genocide of the Yazidis was established by the UN investigative team (UNITAD).

name: Abimael Guzmán
reason: Founder of the Shining Path, held responsible by Peru's Truth Commission for the largest share of the conflict's deaths; convicted of terrorism and aggravated murder.

name: Muammar Gaddafi
reason: Subject of an ICC arrest warrant for crimes against humanity (2011); his regime carried out mass killings, including the 1996 Abu Salim prison massacre.

name: Ruhollah Khomeini
reason: Ordered the 1988 mass executions of thousands of political prisoners, qualified as crimes against humanity by the UN Special Rapporteur on Iran (2024).
